text_block_list.text: Placed on the board. ...Hmph, placed on the board.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The public might think it's kinda meh, huh?
But to Tran-chan—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...If anything, this is where the real fun begins.
choice_data_list: That's a mountain of hints, huh?
That's a mountain of hints, isn't it?
Alright, special training so we can win!

As I am right now, I'm still lacking something
to peer into the 'unknown.'

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we go find it?
That 'tail of the unknown' you're talking about.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Special training, hardcore practice!
And then, once I've powered up to the max—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Lying in wait is the ultimate thrill!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've got that sorted,
let's start our special training tomorrow, alright?
